name: unbluff-skillforge
description: Workspace scripts. Each package keeps its own dependencies and lockfile (backend/, frontend/).

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix frontend ci
scripts.verify: npm run verify:backend && npm run verify:frontend
scripts.verify:backend: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run test:coverage && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.verify:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend test -- --run && npm --prefix frontend run build
